ownership.evidence: Official Stadtwerke publications identify the public TüStrom stations as operated by the Stadtwerke subsidiary ecowerk e-charge GmbH.

currentPublishedAppPricing.context: March/April 2026 Stadtwerke customer magazine describes public AC and DC charging prices and refers to the Lade TüStrom app.

directPayment.reason: The current official publication gives public/app charging prices but does not establish that the same numeric tariff is the contract-free QR/card price at every ecowerk EVSE, nor does it publish station-specific direct-payment payloads.

policy: Keep the 0.42/0.58 EUR/kWh Lade TüStrom price as verified first-party app/eMSP evidence, but do not promote it to a universal physical-CPO ad-hoc fallback until an official QR/card checkout or station-level direct-payment source is available.
